info.name: Campground Booking
info.description:
Campground Booking API (SW Dev Project #2, Group 2 Teletubbies).

Run `node seeder -i` first, select the **Campground Booking** environment, then run the folders in order.

item.name: Register new user (role in body is ignored)
Get me - new user is a regular user

exec: pm.test("Role is user even though role=admin was sent", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.role).to.eql("user"));

item.name: Logout (revokes the token and clears the cookie)
Get me without token after logout -> 401
Get me with the logged-out token -> 401
Get campgrounds with an unknown operator -> 400
Get booking with an invalid id -> 400
User1 update own booking to 4 nights -> 400
User1 update own booking to a past date -> 400
Delete booking with an invalid id -> 400
User1 change dates of a completed booking -> 400

exec: pm.test("Sees bookings from more than one user", () => pm.expect(owners.size).to.be.above(1));

item.name: Admin get bookings for one campground

exec: pm.test("All bookings are for this campground", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(b => pm.expect(b.campground._id).to.eql(id)));

item.name: User1 change dates of a cancelled booking -> 400
